columns.comment: Signal code (upper snake case), e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, UTIL_HIGH, NEWS_ESG_CONTROVERSY.
columns.name: signal_code

columns.comment: Category, e.g. Wallet Leakage, Growth, Liquidity, Credit, News, Market, Rating, Internal Sentiment.
columns.name: signal_category

columns.comment: Opportunity (positive / sales), Risk (negative / early warning) or Neutral (direction from the item's sentiment).
columns.name: polarity

columns.comment: Data quadrant: Internal Quantitative, Internal Qualitative, External Quantitative or External Qualitative.
columns.name: source_quadrant

columns.comment: Producing engine / feed: crm_signal_engine, news_alerts, ews_engine, news_vendor, market_data, rating_agency, jp_share or crm_notes.
columns.name: source_system

columns.comment: Workflow that acts on it: Opportunity Identification, Early Warning or Both.
columns.name: consumed_by

columns.comment: Default strength / weight 0-1 used when ranking a unified signal feed.
columns.name: default_weight

columns.comment: True for signal types derived in gold from news / market / rating / RM-note data (not emitted by a source engine).
columns.name: is_derived_in_gold

columns.comment: Signals of this code recorded by the source engine to the as-of date (0 for gold-derived codes).
columns.name: signals_recorded

comment: Catalogue of every signal code in the Customer 360: CRM opportunity signals (e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, FX_FLOW_VIA_OTHER_BANK, TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH, SCF_ANCHOR_CANDIDATE, CAPEX_NEWS), EWS risk triggers (e.g. UTIL_HIGH, COV_BREACH, DPD_30) and the derived news, market, rating and RM-note signals of the unified signal feed (NEWS_*, MARKET_*, EXT_RATING_*, PARENT_RATING_*, RM_NOTE_*), with polarity, source quadrant, source system, the consuming workflow and a default weight. Grain: one row per signal code.
